page.layout: One column of index entries, one line per entry, running from top to bottom. Below the last entry, at the lower right, one short word.

main_text.l: In Geraris cefsit, pro in Gerara concef-fit. 13.
Lacus, λάκκος, id est, cisterna vel puteus. 16.
Parilis, par: ut imparilis, imparapud Pru-dentium. 112.
Pars turris gader, pro tractu, in quo turris illa. 16.

page.notes: The bottom-right word is faint and may be a catchword or signature; read as "fcx" with doubt. "Prophetisla" is uncertain (the sl ligature could be "Prophetista"). The Greek word after Prophetis is read as προφῆτις from a faint scan. The entry "Pendere / Servitium" is set in two lines and is read in the order printed. Printed "Idololatria" and "Haeresis" lines are kept as printed. No running head or page number is printed.
